items.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Price Rises For Chips And Soda Put 2027 In Focus
items.summary: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) plans to raise prices on chips, sodas, and dips from late 2026 into early 2027. Management links the upcoming price changes to higher ingredient, packaging, and logistics costs across the snacks and beverages portfolio. The timing and scope of the increases suggest a deliberate focus on managing profit margins across PepsiCo's mix of products. PepsiCo's plan for 2026 and 2027 price hikes sits against broader pressures and shifts our research has found in the business...
